text.tagline_ja: 暮らしに、透明なサウンドを。
text.blurb: A hundred and one presets for the moods of modern life: the shopping-mall atrium, the hotel lobby, the aquarium, the moment your computer starts. Designed in Tokyo by Sound Design Group 2.
intro: Thank you for choosing the Lifestyle Aesthetics Pack, Gold Edition. This collection brings the fresh feeling of clean glass, clear water and quiet lobbies to your desktop music.
The presets are arranged in ten moods: Mall, Lobby, Aqua, Glass, Startup, Utopia, Slush, Late Night, Signal and Funk. Each one was designed by the Sound Design Group 2 at Meridian Interactive.
intro_ja: このたびは「ライフスタイル・エステティクス・パック ゴールド・エディション」をお買い上げいただき、誠にありがとうございます。
ショッピングモール、ホテルのロビー、水族館。毎日の風景を、あなたのデスクトップ・ミュージックにお届けします。
maker_note: We wanted to make sounds that feel like a clean screen after you wipe it. Every sound in this collection began as a system sound: a ding, a chime, a click. We slowed them, layered them and let them ring.
We hope the Lifestyle Aesthetics Pack brings a little clear water to your day.
Sound Design Group 2, Meridian Interactive K.K., Tokyo
install: Insert the disc. In the Library tab, the disc appears as the CD-ROM drive LIFESTYLE.
Open a mood folder (Mall, Aqua, Glass ...) and double-click a preset to load it.
To read the manual, open MANUAL.PDF.
